# AppDimens — Documentation Hub

> AppDimens is a family of responsive sizing libraries: you write a design size once (`16.sdp`, `sdp(16)`, `16sdp`, `@dimen/_16sdp`, `{sdp:16}`) and it scales to the current screen — phones, tablets, foldables, TVs, desktops and the web. The same token names and the same math are used on Android (Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Java, XML), Kotlin Multiplatform, Apple platforms (SwiftUI, UIKit), Flutter, React Native, the Web, .NET (MAUI, WPF, WinForms, WinUI, .NET for Android) and Android games. This repository is the hub: it includes every library as a Git submodule and explains the shared ideas. All libraries are in production at version 3.2.0 (Web 3.2.1, .NET 3.6.1).

## Libraries (all Production)

- [appdimens-dynamic](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic) — Android Compose / Kotlin / Java, 3.2.0, Maven `io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-dynamic` (+ `-bom`, `-<strategy>`) — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-sdps](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-sdps) — Android XML `@dimen/_16sdp`, 3.2.0, Maven `io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-sdps` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-sdps/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-ssps](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-ssps) — Android XML text `@dimen/_14ssp`, 3.2.0, Maven `io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-ssps` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-ssps/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-kmp](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-kmp) — Kotlin Multiplatform (Android, iOS, JVM, macOS, Linux, Windows, JS, Wasm), 3.2.0, Maven `io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-kmp` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-kmp/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-ios](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-ios) — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS (SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, Metal), 3.2.0, Swift Package Manager product `AppDimensDynamic`
- [appdimens-flutter](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-flutter) — Flutter, 3.2.0, pub.dev `appdimens_flutter` (+ `appdimens_<strategy>`, `appdimens_bom`) — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-flutter/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-react-native](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-react-native) — React Native, 3.2.0, npm `appdimens-react-native` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-react-native/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-web](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-web) — Web (HTML/CSS, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular), 3.2.1, npm `webdimens` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-web/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-net-binding](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-net-binding) — .NET MAUI, WPF, WinForms, WinUI 3, .NET for Android, 3.6.1, NuGet `Bodenberg.AppDimens.*` and `AppDimens.Net.*` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-net-binding/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-games](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-games) — Android games (Kotlin, Java, C/C++/NDK, OpenGL ES, Vulkan, DirectX, Unity/C#), 3.2.0, Maven `io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-games` — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-games/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-skills](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-skills) — skill pack for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf) covering every library above, 0.1.0, npm `appdimens-skills` (`npx appdimens-skills`); includes a `kit` CLI (`detect`, `normalize`, `compare`, `lint`)

## Token grammar (identical on every platform)

`<prefix><axis><kind><inverter><flags>[Px]`
- axis: `s` smallest side, `h` height, `w` width → `sdp`, `hdp`, `wdp`
- kind: `dp` layout, `sp` text respecting font scale, `em` text ignoring font scale
- inverters: `Ph`, `Lh`, `Pw`, `Lw` (orientation-dependent axis)
- flags: `a` aspect-ratio correction, `i` ignore multi-window, `ia` both; `Px` returns pixels
- Reference canvas 300 × 533: `16.sdp` = 16 × smallestSide / 300

## Strategies (prefixes)

- scaled (default): `sdp`, `ssp`
- auto (recommended for phone + tablet + TV; formerly BALANCED): `asdp`, `assp` — linear up to 480, then `1.6 + 0.4·ln(1 + (d−480)/300)`
- percent (formerly PERCENTAGE / DYNAMIC): `psdp`, `spaceW`
- power: `pwsdp` · fluid: `fsdp` · interpolated: `isdp` · logarithmic: `logsdp`
- diagonal: `dgsdp` · perimeter: `prsdp` · fit: `ftsdp` · fill: `flsdp` · density: `dsdp`
- resize: `autoResizeTextSp`, `AutoResizeText` · units: `mm`, `cm`, `inch`

Obsolete names (do not use): `balanced(…)`, `webdimens.balanced`, `defaultScaling`, `.fxdp`, `.dydp`, `fx`, `dy`, `densdp`, `fillsdp`, `fitsdp`.
